Private recovery & backups

Every confirmed save of a story, page section or Postcard keeps a private saved version with its photo references. Open the item and use Saved versions to recover it.

Independent OneDrive backup status is being checked.

Independent snapshots are stored in your existing OneDrive project under backups/content. They include saved writing, uploaded website photos, saved versions and the private calendar. Unconfirmed browser edits are not included. You can also download a backup from each editor.

Live release preparation

Test environment only. This is preparation, not a production activation. No subscriber email will be sent by these changes.

  • Current staging editors, the new overview, recovery versions and the visual calendar are connected to private test storage.
  • Production CMS, website editing and contact delivery remain closed. Their permissions, migration and checks must be activated together in an approved release.
  • Newsletter sending, contact forwarding and public Postcard archiving have separate switches. They remain off until deliberately enabled in an approved release.
  • Google and Authenticator remain required. No paid server or billing upgrade is needed for this editor.
  • Production verification comes after your explicit approval. Do not treat a successful test publication as a live publication or email delivery.
